summary: Batch 1 frontend test (#2 upgrade button, #3 multi-line + token styling, #6 any-language). CARD DETAIL (host cookie, 1920 + 390): PASS. Free card card_76e6fe90ab9a shows the FREE badge, '0 / 2 guests used', and 'Upgrade this card' after Guest list / Edit (in that order). The usage banner and its Upgrade button show too. Both buttons go to /cards/card_76e6fe90ab9a/upgrade, and the upgrade page loads (Rs. 116.82). On paid cards card_a8c005a026a1 (paid) and card_81fd619150f2 (paid_without_payment), the badge says PAID and the upgrade button, banner and usage count are all absent. The mobile layout wraps cleanly. GUEST /i/test-batch1 (390x844): PASS. 'राधे राधे' uses Noto Serif Devanagari. The greeting shows on 3 lines (pre-line) and the occasion/names tokens are 18.2px (1.3x of 14px), weight 700, accent2 colour. The note shows on 3 lines 'We cordially invite you to join the' / 'Pheras' / 'on [patch].', and the patch is 22.1px like the 22.1px note token. The tap-to-reveal button reveals '10 December 2026' and removes the canvas. The invitation shows its 3 lines as typed, centred. The names आरव/मीरा and the venue गार्डन हॉल use the Devanagari Noto stack and document.fonts.check is true. No tofu appeared in the screenshots. WIZARD (/create, tab 3 Details): PASS with one bug. The greeting, welcome note and invitation are all TEXTAREAs, and Enter adds '\n'. The 4 any-language hints show the exact text. Hindi, Urdu and Gurmukhi typed or pasted (clipboard Ctrl+V) into names, greeting, note and invitation stay intact. The live preview shows the line breaks and scripts. BUG: mixed-script multi-line text is in the wrong order when the field contains Arabic/Urdu (see action_items).

ui_bugs.issue:
The direction for a mixed-script paragraph is set once for the whole block. If Arabic/Urdu is found anywhere in the text, the

gets dir='rtl'. English lines in the same field then show in RTL bidi order. Reproduced in the wizard preview with welcome note 'السلام علیکم Join the {occasion} on {date}.': it shows 'Wedding Join the' and '. — on' (the token and the punctuation move to the wrong side). This is likely for Muslim hosts who start with an Urdu line and continue in English. Fix: add `unicode-bidi: plaintext` to .gc-prewrap (each line then picks its own direction), or split on and render each line with dir='auto'.

issues: The greeting is uppercase (text-transform), so the occasion token shows as 'PHERAS'/'WEDDING' in all-caps Great Vibes script, which is hard to read. Consider text-transform:none on .gc-token.
The 'Tap to reveal' link is small (13px, opacity .8) on the maroon background, so it has low contrast.

action_items: Fix the mixed-script RTL order in TokenText/ScriptText. Add `unicode-bidi: plaintext;` to .gc-prewrap in card/hub.css, or give each line dir='auto', so English lines are not reversed when the same field has an Urdu/Arabic line.

Optional: useScriptFont only detects the FIRST script it finds (in RANGES order), so mixed text loads one font. For example, names 'आरव & ਮੀਰਾ' get only the Devanagari stack and the Gurmukhi part falls back to the system font. Consider detecting all scripts and joining their font stacks.

Optional: card-family-block (e.g. 'Mr. & Mrs. Iqbal Siddiqui ... son आरव with मीरा') does not use ScriptText/useScriptFont, so its Devanagari falls back to the system font (it rendered fine here). Apply useScriptFont to keep it consistent.
critical_code_review_comments: TokenText: dir and font are set from the whole text (detectScript returns the first match), which causes the mixed-script issues above.
CardDetail: the header usage count appears only after /billing loads, so the pill shows up late (it is fine once loaded). The banner already falls back to limit 2, so the header could do the same.
The welcome note default for multi-event cards is '...\n{occasion}\nfrom {date}.' and for single-event cards it is 'on {date}.' The 'from' wording looks intentional; please confirm.
seed_data_creation: None. The wizard tests were not saved (no card was created).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Guest flow: on /i/test-batch1 there is no skip-intro-button. Click intro-open-button, then wait until document.elementFromPoint at welcome-date-reveal-button returns that element. Force clicks earlier hit the intro overlay. Paid host cards: card_a8c005a026a1 (paid) and card_81fd619150f2 (paid_without_payment). Free: card_76e6fe90ab9a and card_d2e758c9caf0. Wizard: /create, wizard-step-tab-2 has the names, greeting, note and invitation fields. In the preview, intro-open-button and then welcome-continue-button. For clipboard paste, use grant_permissions clipboard-read/write and Control+V, and do not click the field again before pasting (the click moves the caret).
